wakad.overview: Wakad is one of Pune's most active mid-market residential suburbs, benefiting from direct access to the Hinjewadi IT Park while staying comparatively affordable versus Hinjewadi itself. Inventory is dominated by mid-rise gated apartment communities.
wakad.connectivity: The Mumbai–Pune Expressway and Mumbai–Bangalore Highway (NH 48) both run near Wakad; the under-construction Metro Line 3 (Hinjewadi–Shivajinagar) will add a station here.
wakad.socialInfra: Schools: Indira National School, Vibgyor High. Hospitals: Aditya Birla Memorial Hospital. Retail: Xion Mall, D-Mart Wakad.
wakad.techParks: Hinjewadi IT Park (Phases 1–3) is a 10–15 minute drive, hosting Infosys, Wipro, and Cognizant campuses.
wakad.upcomingInfra: Pune Metro Line 3 (PCMC–Swargate via Hinjewadi) under construction, expected to add a Wakad-area station.

priceTrend.comparisonNote: Growing faster than Pune's city average, driven by Hinjewadi IT-corridor spillover demand.

rentalYield.note: One of Pune's better rental yields, supported by steady tenant demand from Hinjewadi IT employees.

faq.q: Is Wakad better value than buying directly in Hinjewadi?
faq.a: Wakad typically prices lower per sq.ft. than Hinjewadi itself while staying within a 10–15 minute commute, making it a common value alternative for IT-park employees.

faq.q: What RERA checks apply to a Wakad apartment project?
faq.a: Verify the project's MahaRERA registration number and promoter history on the Maharashtra RERA portal, and confirm the sanctioned building plan matches what's being marketed.

faq.q: What is the average price per sq.ft. in Wakad?
faq.a: Around ₹7,400 per sq.ft. as of this update, with close to 8% year-on-year growth tied to Hinjewadi IT Park demand.

faq.q: Will the upcoming metro line affect Wakad property prices?
faq.a: The under-construction Pune Metro Line 3, connecting Hinjewadi to Shivajinagar, is expected to improve connectivity and is already a factor in current price appreciation ahead of completion.
